Container.Name: NZBPostarr
Container.Overview: Unraid/Docker packaging for the original NZBPostarr project. This container does not patch or modify NZBPostarr application source. It adds only the dependencies and container configuration needed to run the upstream application on Unraid.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Persistent NZBPostarr configuration, history, generated NZBs, and runtime state.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Choose the Unraid host path containing the files NZBPostarr should access. Inside NZBPostarr this path is /data.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID used to run NZBPostarr. 99 is the standard Unraid nobody UID.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID used to run NZBPostarr. 100 is the standard Unraid users GID.
